title: [master]Codeunits 8364, 8365, 8367 Add integration event OnAfterPopulateLineBufferForReporting to filter Dimension Perspective sections before rendering
summary: Three Dimension Perspective codeunits now expose an integration event that allows filtering which sections appear before rendering in financial reports.
key_points: Adds OnAfterPopulateLineBufferForReporting integration event to DimPerspectiveBusinessUnit
Adds OnAfterPopulateLineBufferForReporting integration event to DimPerspectiveCustom
Adds OnAfterPopulateLineBufferForReporting integration event to DimPerspectiveDimension
Enables extensions to control Dimension Perspective section visibility before rendering
Minimal changes with 6 lines per codeunit
